entry.name: zplane~
entry.digest: Graph filter poles and zeros on the Z-plane
entry.description: The zplane~ object provides a way to graph filter poles and zeros in the Z-plane for display. Use the zplane~ object in conjunction with the filtergraph~ object, or provide it with a list of biquad~ coefficients.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Change filter parameters by clicking and dragging in theobject’s display
messages.description: You can change the filter parameters by clicking and dragging on theobject’s display. Clicking and dragging on any of the poles (shown as an x in the display) or zeros (shown as an o in the display) will modify the filter coefficients and output the new filter coefficient values.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Output the current pole and zero values
messages.description: Causes the current pole and zero values to be re-output.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol that references a namedobject dictionary (set via theattribute), will cause theobject to use the dictionary values for filter coefficients.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In 1st-5th inlets: A float in one of the first five inlets changes the current value of the correspondingfilter coefficients (a0, a1, a2, b1, and b2, respectively), recalculates and displays the filter's pole-zero graph on the Z-plane and causes a lists of poles and zeros be output.

messages.name: ft1
messages.description: In 2nd inlet: Sets the current value of thefilter'scoefficient.

messages.name: ft2
messages.description: In 3rd inlet: Sets the current value of thefilter'scoefficient.

messages.name: ft3
messages.description: In 4th inlet: Sets the current value of thefilter'scoefficient.

messages.name: ft4
messages.description: In 5th inlet: Sets the current value of thefilter'scoefficient.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Set filter coefficients, display poles/zeros, and output pole/zero data
messages.description: In left inlet: A list of five float values which correspond tofilter coefficients sets theobject's internal values for these coefficients and causes the object to visually display the poles and zeros for the filter(s) and to output the pole and zero data.If more than five values are sent, they are interpreted as sets of cascaded biquad coefficients. The zplane~ object will display a composite pole-zero graph which shows the multiplication of a group of biquad filters in cascade. Up to 24 groups of five float values may be cascaded.

messages.name: logscale
messages.digest: Select linear or log frequency display
messages.description: The word, followed by a zero or one, toggles between linear (the default) and log frequency display.

messages.name: range
messages.digest: Change the visual scaling of the object's display
messages.description: The word, followed by a floating point value, changes the visual scaling of the zplane~ object's display. The default is 1.5.
